analysis:
Examined all supplied metadata, patches, changelog text and SSD reference surroundings against the canonical definition index and detailed T-041. docs/reference/ssd-kv-cache.md head line 65 documents retaining a complete field/chunk read without an additional copy; line 3 only updates the date. changelog.d/ssd-read-single-copy.md head lines 3–8 describe the same optimization and a debug-build benchmark, not a production qualification claim. These documentation changes introduce no observed weakening of A-001 confidentiality, TB-007 isolation or T-041 mitigations. Surrounding base reference lines 60–82 retain nonce/AAD authentication, HMAC names and path protections; lines 101–126 describe bounded staging and alias retirement, lines 278–290 describe partial-read accounting and authenticated completion, and lines 300–396 describe identity, TTL and write limits. No authorization, attestation, wire encryption, billing, installer or privileged-helper behavior is changed in this evidence.
The implementation of provider-swift/Sources/ProviderCore/KVCacheSSD/SSDBlockStore.swift readExactly is not supplied here; documentation cannot establish its safety. Integration must verify the complete-read fast path and short-read fallback preserve exact-length/EOF handling, pre-read budget charging, size bounds and buffer ownership through authentication/decryption, including SSDBlockChunkCursor and streaming/checkpoint readers. This is a material coverage question for the stated optimization, not evidence of a missing control or a concrete regression. No finding is independently supported by these documentation-only units.
